description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called SettingsRootView for a macOS application, which manages various settings tabs including General, Channels, Voice Wake, Config, and others. It handles UI layout, tab switching, permission monitoring, and integration with app state and notification events.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: Enumeration representing different settings tabs with associated properties like title and system image.

classes.name: SettingsTabRouter
classes.description: Singleton enum providing a way to request and consume pending tab switches in the UI.

methods.name: validTab(for:)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate tab to display, especially fallback for debug tab based on app state.

methods.name: refreshSnapshotPaths()
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes snapshot paths for config and state directory, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: refreshPerms()
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes permission status via the permission monitor.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring(for:)
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the selected tab.

methods.name: stopPermissionMonitoring()
methods.description: Stops permission monitoring when view disappears.
